messages:
Anya (AE): Kicking off the POC check-in for Northerly Bank. They want tenant ownership by domain and are asking about jurisdiction controls before we start the dedicated trial. Key asks below. :wave:
Olivia (Acme IT): Thanks — yes. Primary concerns: 1) can we prove domain ownership without giving org-wide admin rights? 2) data residency: logs/usage must stay in eu-west. 3) SCIM: they only want subset provisioning (users + groups, no attributes beyond email+role).
Martin (SE): Short answers up-front: 1) we support DNS TXT or email-based domain verification; DNS is preferred. 2) Private deploys support region pinning; hosted can be routed to eu region but we need a SLA addendum for residency. 3) SCIM partial sync is possible via attribute filters and group scoping.
Olivia (Acme IT): For DNS flow, can you share the exact TXT record format? Also SAML metadata exchange for their IdP — they want an example entityID and ACS.
Martin (SE): DNS TXT example: `_redwood-acme=verify_8f7a3b`. Command we typically give ops: `dig TXT _redwood-acme.acme.com` to validate after you add it. SAML: our SP entityID is `https://accounts.redwood.ai/sp` and ACS `https://accounts.redwood.ai/saml/acs`. We'll send metadata xml in the follow-up email.
Devon (Product): On tenant ownership: are they trying to host multiple bank subsidiaries under one Redwood customer or separate tenants per legal entity? This affects RBAC & billing.
Olivia (Acme IT): Separate legal entities, but single corporate contract preferred. They need role scoping so subsidiary admins can't access other subsidiaries' prompts/data.
Lee (Security): Important note: we need to confirm audit log residency and retention policy for a Private deployment. Also clarify whether SCIM group sync can be limited to a single domain scope and whether we persist last_login. If they cannot allow last_login, we can disable the attribute.
Anya (AE): Action items: Martin — send SAML metadata + DNS TXT exact string. Lee — prepare residency SLA note and what we can commit for Private vs Hosted. Devon — confirm RBAC model that supports namespace scoping per subsidiary. Ops-bot: Meeting scheduled: POC kickoff demo Wed 10:00am UTC. :calendar:
Martin (SE): Quick SCIM mapping snippet (we'll adjust to their provisioning rules):
```json
{
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User"],
  "userName": "user.email",
  "name": {"givenName": "user.givenName", "familyName": "user.familyName"},
  "emails": [{"value": "user.email", "type": "work"}],
  "roles": "groups[*].displayName"
}
```
Martin (SE): For partial provisioning, ask the IdP team to bind only the groups you want synced (provisioning filter). We'll map groups to Redwood roles during onboarding.
Olivia (Acme IT): Legal also asked whether the SCIM sync creates accounts or just links existing users. Their directory has strict join rules.
Devon (Product): We can support both: create-on-provision or link-only. Need to know which flows they want for the POC. Link-only is usually safer for banks.
Lee (Security): One blocker: their compliance team requests a short questionnaire about encryption-in-transit keys, KMS usage, and HSM for Private. I'll push a one-page security summary today.
Anya (AE): Pricing question from procurement: if they commit to Dedicated (reserved GPUs) for the subsidiaries, can we offer a per-subsidiary seat discount under the single contract? Finance will need an expected token/throughput estimate.
Martin (SE): For pricing we'll need expected rps, avg seq length, and percent streaming vs non-streaming. We can produce a cost model template for them.
Olivia (Acme IT): I'll pull sample traffic numbers and share before Tue. Also confirm: is there a way to delegate domain verification to a subsidiary admin without exposing root billing?
Devon (Product): Yes — domain verification can be delegated via admin roles scoped to a namespace; billing owner is separate. We'll document the exact admin privileges.
Anya (AE): Great. I'll consolidate and send the prep checklist to Olivia after the SAML metadata and the security summary land. Anything else? :eyes:
Olivia (Acme IT): One last thing — can you confirm retention of prompt logs per tenant? They want 90 days by default, 7 years for a few regulated subsidiaries.
Lee (Security): We support configurable retention on Private and Dedicated; hosted needs add-on. I'll include retention options in the security note.
Anya (AE): Perfect. Thanks team — will follow up with copy of SAML metadata + DNS TXT + meeting invite. :thumbsup:
